flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts (type declaration only), pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{useSearch.ts,useSearchParams.tsx} (search by warrant_no), pages/NoticeSearch/form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx; ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (path list only). No entity/controller/service/cron for warrant of arrest in any of the six repos.
note: The story asks for a summary report of warrant update requests sent to State Courts and routing of errors to the OIC dashboard. There is no report, no source sending data (OCMS27.31 is absent), and Dashboard.tsx is empty. The court reports in ActionReport.tsx are Court Application reports with endpoints commented out, not warrant reports, so they are not credited. There is no entity, repository, controller, service, cron or SFTP/API client for Warrant of Arrest in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi or ocmseserviceapi (case-insensitive grep: warrant, woa, state court, send_to_sc, roms_error, warrantofarrest, woc_number; synonyms court mention/trial/outcome also checked). The only traces are the TypeScript type Iwarrantofarrest in ocmsadminui and a GET call to endpoint 'warrantofarrest' used to search notices; the path /v1/warrantofarrest is in the authorization list but no controller or entity serves it. The CAS inbound endpoints in CasIntegrationController (casGetPaymentStatus, casUpdateCourtNotices, plus-get-court-case-info, plus-payment-activation) are not credited: they are calls from CAS/PLUS to OCMS about court notices, not warrant updates to/from State Courts. Story status is blank in the data.
recommendation: Do not claim. The report and routing to the OIC dashboard do not exist and depend on the sending feature of OCMS27.31, which also does not exist.

steps.step: OCMS gathers the warrant update requests sent to State Courts
steps.detail: No warrant sending data exists: send_to_sc_flag/send_to_sc_date are only UI type fields (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:21-22), with no entity/query in ocmsadminprivateapi/src or ocmsadminapi/src. Since there is no send process (see OCMS27.31), there are no records to gather.

steps.step: OCMS produces a summary report of the records sent
steps.detail: The staff report list (ActionReport.tsx:36-62) only has 'Court Application Vault/Submit/Summon/Rejected Reports' with endpoints still commented out (courtcasesummary, lines 39-61); these are court application reports, not warrant updates. There is no warrant report in ReportList*.tsx and no warrant OCMS_REPORT_* mapping in api-authorization.properties.

steps.step: Sending errors are listed in the report
steps.detail: roms_error_code / roms_error_flag are only fields in the UI type (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:28-30); no code fills or reads them.

steps.step: Errors are routed to the OIC dashboard
steps.detail: Dashboard.tsx only renders a DataForm with an empty row (lines 19-34): no widget, API call or error routing to the OIC.
